newCandidatesThisWeek.rationale: Compound hook requiring three simultaneous algorithm signals in first 3 seconds (visual stop-scroll + topic match metadata + completion-arc pacing above 70%) — distinct from existing edit_three_signal_hook which targets general hooks; this variant specifically enforces the 70% completion-rate threshold as an edit constraint, requiring pacing decisions throughout the full clip not just the opening

Completion-optimised cut template that applies tight scripting, zero dead-air trimming, and cadence-matching throughout the full Short — targeting >70% watch-through as the primary output metric; separate from hook-only tools because it governs the entire clip timeline, not just the opening frame

TikTok Shop native CTA overlay: timed Shop Now button prompt synced to product reveal moment, with caption copy optimised for retargeting-eligible viewers; requires a specific overlay timing and caption template that doesn't exist in current tools — distinct from generic text overlays because it must match TikTok Shop's placement spec and conversion intent framing

Pre-hunt loadout gear-check format: flat-lay or hold-up product reveal in named sequence (item 1 → item 2 → final hero item), each with lower-third name tag and price/link area — a policy-safe firearms-niche alternative to range/field footage; the sequencing template and lower-third spec are not covered by existing reveal tools

Instagram-specific completion-arc editing template: hook at frame 0, retention bump at the 50% mark (re-hook or surprise), and a payoff in the final 2 seconds that rewards watch-to-end — enforced as a structural template with mandatory beat positions; different from YouTube completion tools because Instagram's algorithm weights completion independently and the 50%-beat rule is platform-specific

First-person field POV edit template for hunting Reels: helmet/chest-mount or handheld walk-in footage with stabilisation preset, ambient audio preservation, and timed location/situation text card — a hunting-specific POV profile that preserves natural sound (wind, brush, wildlife) as a feature rather than replacing it with music, distinct from edit_pov_transformation_cut which uses music and titles

LinkedIn silent-autoplay caption burning: word-by-word or sentence-by-sentence burned-in subtitle track optimised for muted viewing, with LinkedIn's square/portrait crop spec and professional caption styling (no emoji, no wave-form, clean sans-serif) — a distinct export profile for LinkedIn's professional environment vs existing caption tools tuned for TikTok/Reels aesthetics
